question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A detailed description of a series of real or fictional events taking place over a long period of time
solution:
The correct answer is: **Saga**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **saga **is a one-word substitute for a detailed description of a series of real or fictional events taking place over a long period of time. (एक लंबी अवधि में घटित होने वाली वास्तविक या काल्पनिक घटनाओं की श्रृंखला का विस्तृत विवरण)
 
• It is derived from the Old Norse word "saga" which means a "story".
 
• Sagas are typically associated with Scandinavian literature and folklore.
 
• Examples of famous sagas include the **Icelandic sagas**, the **Njundefinedls saga**, and the **Vinland sagas**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Witness**: A witness is a person who sees an event take place and can testify about it in court. (गवाह वह व्यक्ति होता है जो किसी घटना को घटित होते देखता है और अदालत में इसके बारे में गवाही दे सकता है)
 
• **Journal**: A journal is a daily record of events or personal thoughts. (जर्नल घटनाओं या व्यक्तिगत विचारों का दैनिक रिकॉर्ड है)
 
• **Case study**: A case study is an in-depth analysis of a particular event, person, or situation. (केस स्टडी किसी विशेष घटना, व्यक्ति या स्थिति का गहन विश्लेषण है)
